CweFindings.Name: Use of Hard-coded Password
CweFindings.Description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.
CweFindings.Explanation: The SQL administrator password is constructed in the deployment template from a fixed literal prefix and a deterministic value derived from public deployment inputs. This embeds a predictable credential-generation pattern in source-controlled infrastructure.

CweFindings.Name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
CweFindings.Description: The product allows the upload or transfer of dangerous file types that are automatically processed within its environment.
CweFindings.Explanation: PhotoService.UploadPhotoAsync accepts files based on the client-supplied ContentType allowlist. ImageSharp decoding failures are caught and treated as non-fatal, after which the original contents are saved and can be served by PhotoFileModel using the stored MIME type. Thus a non-image payload can be stored and made available as an image upload by claiming an allowed MIME type.
